title: Clean up text without needless copies
hints: Trimming never needs a copy: `text.trim_matches(|c| c == ' ' || c == '\t')` (like `trim`, but you say which characters to strip) returns a slice of the input. Check that slice for anything that needs rewriting; if there is nothing, `Cow::Borrowed(trimmed)` is the answer.
A single tab also has to become a space, so it counts as needing a rewrite even when it is not part of a run.
